scope: Post-result parent producer / group-action / DM->CFR equivalence audit of two pinned CFR(5,27) candidates. No gate, novelty or priority claim.

verdicts.producer_reproduction: PASS: rebuilt binary from frozen source; both deterministic models regenerate DM raws byte-identical to the parent pins A-DM.raw and B-DM.raw

non_claims: No claim that A and B are non-isomorphic, or isomorphic, under any equivalence; nothing was tested.
The G-invariance is a statement about the DM column multiset with columns taken modulo constants; no CFR row-isotopy, CFR automorphism or CFR-level symmetry is claimed.
No gate, novelty or priority claim; a search miss is not novelty.
Raw witness validity rests on the definition checks of the raw bytes, not on the symmetry model or producer.
Producer success is not witness validity; raw validity was established by the parent definition-first checker and is re-confirmed here only as an extra independent definition check.

group_action_audit.arithmetic: cyclic Z_27 (integers mod 27) everywhere except the explicitly labelled Z_3^3 controls
group_action_audit.action_definition: (g c)_x = mu * c_{pi^-1(x)} mod 27 (pi[i] = image of row i), then subtract the column's first entry

T10-zero-first.rule: b_j[c]=(D_j[c]-D_0[c]) mod 27; x=b_1[c]; CFR row j-1 has symbol x at position b_j[c] (j=1..5)

dm_to_cfr.converse_explanation: DM -> CFR: subtracting D_0 columnwise keeps every row-pair difference multiset, so b_0 = 0 and each b_j (j >= 1) is a bijection columns -> Z_27 (pair (0,j)); hence CFR row j-1 (symbol b_1[c] at position b_j[c]) is a permutation. If rows j != j' shared (a,b,d) with a = b_1[c] != b = b_1[c'], then b_j[c'] - b_j[c] = b_j'[c'] - b_j'[c], i.e. (b_j - b_j')[c] = (b_j - b_j')[c'], contradicting the DM property of pair (j,j'). Converse CFR -> DM: with D'_0 = 0 and D'_j[s] = pos_{j-1}(s), pair (0,j) is a bijection because each row is a permutation, and a repeated difference in pair (j,j') at symbols a != b is exactly a shared (a,b,d) with d != 0. Every subtraction is mod 27 (Z_27); the Z_3^3 controls show the same arrays are not DMs/CFRs over the additive group of GF(27).
